title: Internet Security Glossary, Version 2
summary: A large glossary of information security terms, abbreviations, and explanations, meant to help authors of Internet documents use security vocabulary consistently. It gives recommendations on choosing terms: reuse the same term for the same concept, prefer plain dictionary meanings, and avoid terms that favor a particular vendor. It is informational and a handy reference.

eli5.summary: A giant dictionary of computer-safety words, so everyone who writes about internet security uses the same word for the same thing.
